user_question: Why does ESP32 keep rebooting with 'Brownout detector was triggered'?
expected_root_cause: Power supply voltage dropping below brownout threshold (typically ~2.7V) under load
expected_fix: Use stable 3.3V supply with adequate current capacity; add decoupling capacitors; check USB cable/port current limit

expected_serial_log_events.message: Brownout detector was triggered - supply voltage too low
expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Insufficient power supply current or voltage drop under load
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Measure 3.3V rail with multimeter under load; use powered hub or better supply; add 100uF + 100nF decoupling

expected_follow_up_required: Check ESP32 datasheet for brownout detector voltage threshold
